title: A step toward: The 11-vertex graph G11 (no 4-cycle, cover number 7): least top-form fan-in-exactly-two AND/OR circuits with 2+ junk ANDs have at least 22 gates (step 2 of 2)
statement: let x1 : SimpleGraph (Fin (11 : ℕ)) := PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.edgeGraph (11 : ℕ) [((0 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (4 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (6 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((7 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((8 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ))]; ∀ (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   x2.size ≤ (21 : ℕ) →     PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO x1 x2 →       PEqualNP.TopForm.TopForm x1 x2 →         (2 : ℕ) ≤ (PEqualNP.TopForm.junk x1 x2).card →           have x7 : Finset (Sym2 (Fin (11 : ℕ))) := PEqualNP.TopForm.Ustar x1 x2;           have x8 : ℕ := (2 : ℕ) * (PEqualNP.TopForm.centreless x1 x2).card + (PEqualNP.TopForm.junk x1 x2).card + (PEqualNP.TopForm.orN x1 x2 \ PEqualNP.TopForm.lam x1 x2).card;           x7.card ≤ x8 → x8 < (2 : ℕ) * x7.card → ∃ (x11 : Finset (Fin (11 : ℕ))) (x12 : Finset (Fin (11 : ℕ))), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsMinCover (x1.deleteEdges ↑x7) x11 ∧ x1.IsVertexCover ↑(x11 ∪ x12) ∧ x12.card ≤ x8 - x7.card
